name: Void Chomper
description: Floating fanged abyssal maw orb with articulated jaw teeth and crimson eyes.
descriptionJa: ギザギザの牙が噛み合う不気味で可愛い闇の浮遊モンスター。

name: Piggyback Monkeys
description: Playful ginger monkey floating along with its tiny baby clinging on its back!
descriptionJa: 背中にちび子ザルをおんぶした仲良しおさるペット。

name: Chibi Ender Dragon
ja: ちびエンダードラゴン
description: Iconic blocky mini Ender Dragon with square snout and glowing spine plates.
descriptionJa: 四角い鼻面と光る背板が愛らしいちびエンダードラゴン。

name: Floating Mochi Cat
description: Blissfully round loaf-shaped striped cat with tucked paws and whiskers.
descriptionJa: まんまるお餅フォルムでふよふよ漂うしましま猫。

name: Calico Kitten
description: Playful calico kitten wearing a golden bell collar with tall curled tail.
descriptionJa: 金の鈴首輪としっぽが揺れる愛らしい三毛子猫。

name: Mini Grim Reaper
description: Hooded floating grim reaper with hollow glowing eyes and curved scythe!
descriptionJa: フードの奥に瞳が光り、大鎌を携えて漂うミニ死神。

name: UFO Alien
description: Cute green alien piloting a spinning translucent-domed flying saucer!
descriptionJa: 回転する円盤とトラクタービームで飛ぶ緑のエイリアン。

name: Chrono Raven
description: Flapping obsidian raven clutching a swinging golden pocket watch!
descriptionJa: 揺れる黄金の懐中時計を運ぶ黒鴉。

name: Chill Capybara
description: Unbothered blocky-snout capybara balancing a glowing orange yuzu on its head!
descriptionJa: 頭にゆずを乗せてマイペースに浮かぶ癒しのカピバラ。

name: Abyssal Hatchling
description: Four-eyed obsidian hatchling with shoulder spines and twin shadow tails.
descriptionJa: 四つの瞳と双尾を持つ虚無のアビス幼体。

name: Mini Adventurer
description: A tiny floating humanoid adventurer carrying a mini diamond sword on his back!
descriptionJa: 小さなダイヤ剣を背負って応援してくれるミニ冒険者。

name: Chicken Jockey
description: Classic tiny green zombie with outstretched arms riding a flapping white chicken!
descriptionJa: 羽ばたくニワトリに乗ったお馴染みのちびゾンビ！

name: Cool Cockatiel
ja: サングラスオカメインコ
description: Yellow-crested cockatiel wearing tiny dark sunglasses and rosy cheeks!
descriptionJa: 黒サングラスがキマってるクールなオカメインコ。

name: Fluffy Lamb
description: Sculpted cloud-wool fleece lamb with drooping ears and tiny hooves.
descriptionJa: もこもこの羊毛に包まれた癒しの白子羊。

name: Astral Owl
description: Tufted great owl with wide feathered disc face and gleaming golden eyes.
descriptionJa: 耳羽と黄金の瞳で夜空を見通す星界の大フクロウ。

name: Cerberus
description: Fearsome twin-headed obsidian hellhound with independent snarling heads!
descriptionJa: 二つの頭が別々に動く漆黒の冥界犬ケルベロス。

name: Golden Retriever
ja: ゴールデンレトリバー
description: Cheerful golden retriever with floppy ears, gold tag & wagging feathered tail.
descriptionJa: 垂れ耳とふさふさのしっぽを振る人懐っこいゴールデンレトリバー。

name: Rainbow Unicorn
ja: レインボーユニコーン
description: Majestic pearl-white unicorn with a glowing golden horn and rainbow mane!
descriptionJa: 黄金の角と虹のたてがみが輝く伝説のユニコーン。

name: Void Rune Tiger
description: Obsidian armored tiger crowned by a floating silver crescent moon halo.
descriptionJa: 背に白銀の三日月光輪を浮かべた聖獣ルーンタイガー。

name: Magma Rune Tiger
description: Volcanic obsidian tiger with jagged glowing magma dorsal spine ridges!
descriptionJa: 背中に灼熱の溶岩棘が連なる炎のルーンタイガー。

name: Cyber Rune Tiger
description: Stealth cyber tiger equipped with neon visor optics & twin shoulder pods!
descriptionJa: ネオンバイザーと肩部推進ポッドを備えたサイバータイガー。

name: Crimson Rune Tiger
description: Horned crimson war-tiger with swept scarlet horns and spiked pauldrons!
descriptionJa: 深紅の双角と棘付き肩甲を纏う紅蓮の戦虎。

name: Ginger Tabby
description: Plump playful orange-and-white tabby cat with wide cheeks & bouncy tail.
descriptionJa: ふっくら頬と元気なしっぽが可愛い茶トラ猫。

name: Steampunk Mech
ja: スチームパンクメック
description: Articulated armored bipedal mech-suit with glowing cyan cockpit and arm cannon!
descriptionJa: 二足歩行で轟音と共に追従する武装メックウォーカー。

name: Snowy Terrier
description: Compact scruffy white terrier puppy with bushy beard & bright red bow.
descriptionJa: もじゃもじゃヒゲと赤いリボンが可愛い小柄なテリア犬。

name: Doberman
description: Tall sleek black-and-tan guard dog with cropped ears & spiked collar.
descriptionJa: ピンと立った耳と精悍な体格の忠実なドーベルマン。

name: Siberian Husky
description: Fluffy-ruffed northern husky with icy blue eyes and thick wolf plume tail.
descriptionJa: 豊かな首毛と氷色の瞳が凛々しいシベリアンハスキー。

name: Tuxedo Cat
description: Dapper black-and-white tuxedo cat wearing a tiny crimson bow-tie & mini top hat!
descriptionJa: 小さなシルクハットと蝶ネクタイがお洒落なハチワレ猫。

name: Shiba Inu
description: Round-cheeked Shiba Inu with curly donut tail & Japanese teal neckerchief!
descriptionJa: 唐草バンダナとくるんと巻いた尻尾がたまらない柴犬。

name: Border Collie
description: Agile herding collie with folded tipped ears and flowing white chest ruff.
descriptionJa: 先が折れた耳と白い胸毛が賢そうなボーダーコリー。

name: Lop-Eared Bunny
description: Adorable hopping grey-and-white bunny with long floppy ears.
descriptionJa: 長い垂れ耳を揺らしながらぴょんぴょん跳ねるうさぎ。

name: Shadow Cobra
description: Coiled indigo-black serpent swaying hypnotically with glowing eyes.
descriptionJa: 鎌首をもたげてうねる漆黒のシャドウコブラ。

name: Horned Bone Demon
description: Floating horned skeletal guardian radiating ghostly violet eyes.
descriptionJa: 大角と光る瞳を持つ浮遊する骸骨の魔神。

name: Midnight Tarantula
ja: ミッドナイトタランチュラ
description: Bulky fuzzy eight-legged tarantula with thick furry legs & pedipalps!
descriptionJa: 太く毛深い8本脚で力強く歩く藍色のタランチュラ。

name: Black Widow
description: Sleek spindly-legged jet-black widow marked with a raised glowing crimson hourglass!
descriptionJa: 細長い脚と背中の光る赤い砂時計模様が特徴の漆黒毒蜘蛛。

name: Crawling Hand
description: Spooky articulated five-fingered skeletal hand scuttling beside you!
descriptionJa: 5本の指でカタカタと隣を這い回るホラー系コンパニオン。

name: Siamese Cat
description: Tall slender long-legged Siamese cat with big wedge ears & whip tail.
descriptionJa: すらりとした長い脚と大きな耳が上品なシャム猫。

name: Lucky Black Cat
description: Mystical sleek black cat wearing a glowing golden crescent-moon charm!
descriptionJa: 光る三日月チャームを首に下げた神秘の黒猫。

name: Royal Chick
description: Hilariously round fluffy cream chick crowned like tiny royalty!
descriptionJa: 小さな黄金の王冠をかぶったまんまるひよこ王。
